SELECT count(0) FROM logging_event WHERE arg0 = 'read'

select event_id "id", arg2 "creator", FROM_UNIXTIME(timestmp/1000,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') "date", arg3 "name", arg1 "time", caller_method "method" from logging_event where arg0='read' ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT #{offSet}, #{pageRow}

select event_id id, arg2 creator, to_char(to_timestamp( timestmp/1000), 'YYYY MM DD HH24:MI:SS') "date", arg3 "name", arg1 "time", caller_method "method" from logging_event where arg0='read' ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT #{offSet}, #{pageRow}

select id "id", sub_type "subtype", DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') "date", operator "creator", action "action", extra "extra", fail "res" from t_logrecord where type='FILE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offSet}, #{pageRow}

select id "id", sub_type "subtype", to_char(create_time, 'YYYY MM DD HH24:MI:SS') "date", operator "creator", action "action", extra "extra", fail "res" from t_logrecord where type='FILE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offSet}, #{pageRow}
